content: Arabic RTL/typography best practice: use Naskh-style fonts (Noto Naskh Arabic, SF Arabic, Cairo, Dubai) for readability; Arabic text needs ~10-15% larger size and increased line-height vs Latin equivalents; avoid thin font weights (medium performs better); full RTL mirroring needed for nav/icons/alignment while numerals and logos stay LTR; test rendering with real Arabic content across screen sizes since dense Arabic script can crowd small screens.
